profile: Mac Companion local XPC menu pairing commands v0.1
rules: same-team exact-role authentication and menu readiness are required before command traffic
the menu client and Agent server each admit exactly one command at a time per authenticated generation
request and success payloads are nonempty canonical JSON data no larger than 4096 bytes
each request and success reply has exactly kind, signed integer version 1, and payload
each handled failure has exactly kind and signed integer version 1 and discloses no detail
typed payload decoding and authorization occur again before Agent authority invocation
the server times out after four monotonic seconds and the client after five
timeout, cancellation after send, malformed reply, unknown field, cross-kind payload, premature traffic, and concurrent admission terminate the generation
presentation owners retain exact commands for explicit retry and delivery alone is never success
QR payloads, review decisions, receipts, and errors never enter diagnostics, logs, crash metadata, or the diagnostic CLI
